title: Come and See What God Has Done

questions.question: Shout for joy to God, all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:1 (ESV): "Shout for joy to God, all the earth;"

questions.question: Sing the glory of his name; give to him glorious what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:2 (ESV): "sing the glory of his name; give to him glorious praise!"

questions.question: Say to God, "How awesome are your what!"
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:3 (ESV): "Say to God, 'How awesome are your deeds!'"

questions.question: So great is your power that your enemies come cringing to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:3 (ESV): "...your enemies come cringing to you."

questions.question: All the earth worships you and sings praises to you; they sing praises to your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:4 (ESV): "...they sing praises to your name."

questions.question: Come and see what God has done: he is awesome in his deeds toward the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:5 (ESV): "...he is awesome in his deeds toward the children of man."

questions.question: He turned the sea into what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:6 (ESV): "He turned the sea into dry land;"

questions.question: They passed through the river how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:6 (ESV): "...they passed through the river on foot."

questions.question: You kept our soul among the living and did not let our feet do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:9 (ESV): "...and did not let our feet slip."

questions.question: For you, O God, have tested us; you have tried us as what is tried?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:10 (ESV): "For you, O God, have tested us; you have tried us as silver is tried."

questions.question: You brought us into the net; you laid a crushing burden on our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:11 (ESV): "...you laid a crushing burden on our loins;"

questions.question: We went through fire and through water; yet you have brought us out to a place of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:12 (ESV): "...yet you have brought us out to a place of abundance."

questions.question: I will come into your house with burnt offerings; I will perform my vows to you, that which my lips uttered when I was in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:14 (ESV): "...that which my lips uttered and my mouth promised when I was in trouble."

questions.question: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fattened animals, with the smoke of the sacrifice of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:15 (ESV): "...with the smoke of the sacrifice of rams;"

questions.question: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 66:18 (ESV): "If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened."

key_verse_text: Come and hear, all you who fear God, and I will tell what he has done for my soul.
